title: Voice: a long dictated request with pauses and a self-correction, in one turn

personas.persona: A slow, thoughtful talker who dictates a whole spec in one go, thinking aloud with pauses and 'um's, and corrects themselves mid-way.
goals: In ONE long spoken turn (at least six sentences, set "pauses": true), dictate this request: a tiny HTTP service in a folder named pingd, Python standard library only; GET /health answers JSON with ok true; GET /time answers JSON with the current unix time as an integer under the key time; any other path is a 404; it listens on port eight thousand — then, still in the same turn, correct yourself: no wait, make that port eight one hundred; and it must come with pytest tests that start the server on a free port.
Get it built exactly as dictated (port 8100, not 8000).
At the end, ask how it was tested and finish.
script: First turn: the whole dictation in one say action with "pauses": true, ending with 'over'.
Then wait for main to come back with the result; ask how it was tested; finish.

checks.name: not the first-said port 8000 as the default
pingd tests pass
checks.cmd: cd pingd && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out
